item.title: Church leaders in Kenya and Zimbabwe unveil disability rights action plans
item.description: A three-day training workshop on the domestication and implementation of the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ​concluded in Nairobi on 27 November, with church leaders from Kenya and Zimbabwe, designing action plans for their work in the next two years.

item.title: Zimbabwe urged to defer proposed customs duty hike on specific fabrics
item.description: Stakeholders in Zimbabwe’s cotton and apparel value chain recently urged the government to temporarily shelve the proposed hike in customs duty on selected polyester staple fibres (PSF) with dyed woven fabrics of cotton until the completion of an underway industry study.

item.title: CNRG raises alarm over alleged media capture and grave exhumations linked to lithium mining in Buhera
item.description: The Centre for Natural Resource Governance (CNRG) has raised serious allegations that some Zimbabwean journalists were offered money to undermine community testimony during a press conference addressing grave exhumations linked to lithium mining in Buhera, in a development that has reignited debate over media ethics, corporate influence and the treatment of rural communities in mining areas.
